name: Wilderness Ridge Resort
description: Float service and resort on the Big Piney at Duke, in the Mark Twain National Forest: canoeing, rafting and tubing with shuttles, tent camping, RV hookups, cabins and a small store carrying snacks, ice and firewood.

name: Peck's Last Resort
description: Family-run campground and float service in the Mark Twain National Forest at Duke, renting canoes, rafts and kayaks for half- and full-day floats of up to 15 miles, with canoes available for multi-day trips as far as 45 miles. Tent and group camping, RV sites, cabins, showers and a store.
seasonal_notes: The mini cabin is out of service following flood damage in November.

name: Devil's Elbow River Safari
description: Campground and float service on the Big Piney at Devil's Elbow on Route 66, with 50 tent sites and 7 RV sites — 50-amp, back-in and pull-through — plus primitive camping, a shower house, a pavilion and boat rentals with shuttles.
